description: Makes a potty (toilet/house-training) schedule for a puppy aged 8 to 52 weeks: how long it can usually hold it, how often to take it out during the day, whether to plan night trips, and a sample day with clock times from wake-up to bedtime. For questions about how often to take a puppy out to pee, puppy potty or house-training schedules, and night-time potty trips. Age is in weeks (1 month is about 4.3 weeks). Gives general guidance based on vet and kennel-club sources (VCA, AKC, PetMD), not veterinary advice; not for adult dogs' medical problems such as accidents, diarrhoea or frequent urination.

age_weeks.description: The puppy's age in whole weeks, 8 to 52.

language.description: The language the user is writing in, as a language code (e.g. en, de, sv, pt-BR, es-MX, ja, ar). The answer comes back in that language.

wake.description: When the household gets up, 24-hour HH:MM. Default 07:00.

name: calculate_puppy_potty_schedule
title: Puppy potty schedule
